Certainly! Here’s a **Delay Courier Template** you can use to notify customers about a shipment delay. You can customize it according to your needs:

---

### Subject: Delay in Your Courier Delivery

Dear [Customer Name],

We regret to inform you that your courier shipment with tracking number [Tracking Number] has been delayed due to [brief reason, e.g., unforeseen circumstances, weather conditions, operational issues].

We understand the importance of timely delivery and sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. We are working diligently to ensure your package is delivered as soon as possible. The new expected delivery date is [New Expected Delivery Date/Time].

If you need further assistance or have any questions, please feel free to contact our customer support at [Customer Support Phone/Email].

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,  
[Your Name / Courier Company Name]  
[Contact Information]

---

Would you like a template for notifying business partners/clients, for internal use, or for customers? Let me know if you would like it in a different tone (formal/casual) or for WhatsApp/SMS as well!
